intro: All stays include medication administration, mobility assistance, and detailed wellness logs. Specialized in calm, in-home support for pets who benefit from consistency, supervision, and gentle routine-based care.

serviceArea: Proudly serving San Diego and surrounding areas. Travel fees may apply outside this area.
details: All new clients begin with an in-home complimentary visit and a comprehensive Care Plan Review to ensure a perfect match.
Hygiene Maintenance: Gentle sanitary cleanup or sponge-bathing for senior pets to ensure they remain clean & comfortable.
Feline Friends: The same vigilance and presence is available for senior and special-needs cats. Specialized in CKD management and medication administration at owner's request.
At the end of every stay, you'll receive a digital wellness log detailing medication times, mobility notes, and appetite tracking so you stay in the loop.
Holiday Rates: A 50% surcharge applies to major holidays.
Last-minute Bookings: Requests with less than 24 hours' notice may incur an additional fee.
The Mazzy Legacy: Sunset Paws is a proud supporter of The Animal Pad's Medical Fund — an all-breed, non-profit Dog Rescue Organization based in San Diego, CA.
